mapper.sql: id, user_id, anniversary_id, style, cache_key_suffix, feedback, copy_preview, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_copy_feedback (user_id, anniversary_id, style, cache_key_suffix, feedback, copy_preview, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{anniversaryId}, #{style}, #{cacheKeySuffix}, #{feedback}, #{copyPreview}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_copy_feedback SET feedback = #{feedback}, copy_preview = #{copyPreview}, anniversary_id = COALESCE(#{anniversaryId}, anniversary_id), style = #{style}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_copy_feedback (user_id, anniversary_id, style, cache_key_suffix, feedback, copy_preview, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{anniversaryId}, #{style}, #{cacheKeySuffix}, #{feedback}, #{copyPreview}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE feedback = VALUES(feedback), copy_preview = VALUES(copy_preview), anniversary_id = COALESCE(VALUES(anniversary_id), anniversary_id), style = VALUES(style), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT style, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_count FROM ai_copy_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY style
